cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.description: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.
